DitherBeams.origin: Where the light comes from, as fractions of the box from the top left. Put it outside the box for a light just out of frame, or far away for near-parallel rays from an edge.
DitherBeams.angle: Direction the light points, in degrees as in CSS: 180 is down.
DitherBeams.spread: Width of the cone of light, in degrees.
DitherBeams.sweep: How far the rays sweep back and forth, in degrees. 0 holds them still.
DitherBeams.reach: How far the light reaches from where it enters the box, as a share of the box diagonal.
